name: Speedy
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity or Constitution 13+ You gain the following benefits.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Increase your Dexterity or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

features.name: Dash over Difficult Terrain
features.description: When you take the Dash action on your turn, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.

features.name: Agile Movement
features.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.
